title: CANDOR-Bench: Benchmarking In-Memory Continuous ANNS under Dynamic Open-World Streams [Experiments & Analysis]
bound_sents: O5: Ingestion upper bound as a leading indicator of continuous throughput.
Ingestion Throughput Upper Bound (ops/sec) competitive mainly on high-dimensional Msong, graph indexes are slower overall, and the treebased Sptag is slowest.
